name: Dolphin
summary: A playful, intelligent bottlenose that navigates by sound and can outpace most swimmers.
book_note: Book lists PL3, but its own Fortitude 5 + Will 3 = 8 exceeds the PL3 limit of 6; listed here at PL4 with the book stats unchanged.

name: Ape
summary: A great ape such as a gorilla: massively strong, quick to intimidate, and dangerous when cornered.

name: Shark
summary: A mid-sized predatory shark that follows blood in the water and strikes from below.
book_note: Book totals Powers as 9, but Damage 1 + Protection 3 + Senses 2 + Swimming 4 = 10, so the true total is 31.

name: Hawk
summary: A sharp-eyed bird of prey that dives on small game from high above.
book_note: Book totals are Abilities 6 + Powers 11 = 17; printed STR -2 already includes Shrinking 8 (base STR 0), so abilities cost 8, and Flight 2 (Wings) 2 + Senses 2 + Shrinking 8 = 12 powers, for 27. The book's Close Combat: Claws is its unarmed talon attack, so it is recorded as Close Combat: Unarmed.

name: Lion
summary: The big cat of the savanna: a stealthy stalker that finishes prey with a pounce and raking claws.
book_note: Book totals Powers as 8, but Growth 2 (4) + Protection 4 + Senses 2 = 10, so the true total is 47. The book's Close Combat: Claws is its unarmed attack, recorded as Close Combat: Unarmed.

name: Whale
summary: A fifty-foot humpback or sperm whale; adjust Growth for bigger or smaller species.
book_note: Book gives Athletics 8 (printed +8, ignoring STR 12); with STR 12 that is +20, over the PL8 skill cap of +18, so Athletics is reduced to 6 (+18). That trims 1 point: 45 instead of 46.

name: Wolf
summary: A wild canine pack hunter that wears prey down and drags it off its feet.

name: Dog
summary: A typical medium-sized family dog: loyal, loud, and quick to notice strangers.

name: Guard Dog
summary: A trained attack dog (shepherd, rottweiler, or similar) that bites and holds on until called off.

name: Cat
summary: A house or alley cat. Small, nimble, and very hard to catch; its claws are more nuisance than danger.

name: Horse
summary: A riding or draft horse; a strong runner and a common mount, with a kick that can break bones.

name: Cow
summary: A placid dairy or beef cow. Heavy and hard to move, but rarely aggressive.

name: Bull
summary: An ill-tempered breeding bull or rodeo bull that charges anything that annoys it.

name: Pig
summary: A full-grown farm hog: stubborn, sturdy, and nastier than it looks if it bites.

name: Goat
summary: A sure-footed goat that climbs anything, eats everything, and headbutts whoever is in the way.

name: Chicken Flock
summary: A squawking, pecking mob of farmyard chickens, treated as a single swarm. Mostly a comic distraction.

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: A mass of many small creatures; pours through any gap and is hard to hurt with single blows

name: Rat
summary: A single sewer or pet rat; quick, sneaky, and able to squeeze almost anywhere.

name: Rat Swarm
summary: A seething tide of rats pouring out of a sewer or basement and gnawing everything in reach.

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: A mass of many small creatures; pours through any gap and is hard to hurt with single blows

name: Pigeon Flock
summary: An explosion of startled pigeons that fills the air with wings and feathers, blinding anyone caught in it.

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: A mass of many small creatures; pours through any gap and is hard to hurt with single blows

name: Raccoon
summary: A masked bandit of the alleys with clever hands that open latches, lids, and the occasional window.

name: Stray Dog Pack Leader
summary: The scarred, half-wild boss of a pack of city strays. Use regular dogs for the rest of the pack.

name: Grizzly Bear
summary: A half-ton brown bear able to shred a car door with its claws; most dangerous when protecting cubs.

name: Black Bear
summary: A smaller forest bear that raids campsites and trash cans and climbs trees with ease.

name: Polar Bear
summary: The largest land predator: a patient arctic hunter, at home on the ice or in freezing water.

name: Silverback Gorilla
summary: The dominant male of a gorilla troop. Usually peaceful, but its bluff charges are terrifying and its strength is real.

name: Tiger
summary: The largest of the big cats: a solitary ambush hunter that strikes from cover with overwhelming force.

name: Leopard
summary: A leopard or black panther: a silent climber that drags its kills up into the trees.

name: Cheetah
summary: The fastest land animal, able to outrun a car on the highway for a short sprint.

name: Wolf Pack Alpha
summary: The lead wolf of a pack, bigger and smarter than the rest. Pair it with several ordinary wolves.

name: Coyote
summary: A wily scavenger equally at home in the desert and the suburbs.

name: Deer
summary: A skittish deer that bolts at the first sign of danger. A rutting buck will fight with its antlers.

name: Moose
summary: A towering northern deer with a short temper and broad antlers; it injures more people than bears do.

name: Elephant
summary: An African or Asian elephant, smart and social, able to flatten a vehicle when enraged.

name: Rhinoceros
summary: A near-sighted armored tank of an animal that charges first and investigates later.

name: Hippopotamus
summary: A territorial river giant with a jaw that can bite a canoe in half.

name: Wild Boar
summary: A bristly forest hog with razor tusks that keeps fighting long after it should have fallen.

name: Cape Buffalo
summary: A savanna buffalo known for circling back to ambush the hunters tracking it.

name: Hyena
summary: A cackling clan hunter whose jaws crack bone. Rarely encountered alone.

name: Eagle
summary: A large eagle with a seven-foot wingspan, able to spot a rabbit from a mile up.

name: Owl
summary: A silent night hunter that locates prey in total darkness by sound alone.

name: Raven
summary: A clever black bird that steals shiny things, solves puzzles, and can mimic a few words.

powers.name: Mimicry
powers.detail: Mimics simple sounds and a few words

name: Vulture
summary: A patient carrion bird that circles anything that looks close to death.

name: Alligator
summary: A swamp or sewer gator that waits motionless at the waterline, then grabs and drags its prey under.

name: Saltwater Crocodile
summary: A twenty-foot estuary crocodile, the largest living reptile, with the strongest bite on record.

name: Python
summary: A huge constrictor that coils around its victim and squeezes a little tighter with every breath.

name: Cobra
summary: A hooded snake whose neurotoxic bite can stop a grown man's breathing.

powers.name: Venomous Bite
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (neurotoxin)

name: Rattlesnake
summary: A desert pit viper that rattles a warning before it strikes; its venom causes swelling and collapse.

powers.name: Venomous Bite
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (hemotoxin)

name: Komodo Dragon
summary: A giant island monitor lizard whose toxic bite leaves its prey to weaken and fall.

linked.name: Toxic Saliva
linked.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated

name: Sea Turtle
summary: A big ocean turtle with a heavy shell, slow on land but graceful in the water.

name: Orca
summary: A killer whale: a brilliant, coordinated pod hunter that can snatch seals off the ice.

name: Great White Shark
summary: A twenty-foot apex shark that senses a heartbeat through the water and hits like a truck.

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Low-light Vision, Scent, Extended Scent, Detect Electric Fields

name: Octopus
summary: A clever, color-changing octopus that escapes through tiny gaps and hides behind a cloud of ink.

powers.name: Ink Cloud
powers.detail: Visibility only: a cloud of ink imposes -5 on visual Perception; Limited to underwater

powers.name: Boneless
powers.detail: Boneless; squeezes through any gap larger than its beak

name: Giant Squid
summary: A forty-foot deep-sea squid with ten grasping arms, rarely seen at the surface.

name: Piranha Swarm
summary: A frenzied school of piranhas that strips anything in the water to the bone.

powers.name: Feeding Frenzy
powers.detail: Limited to targets in the water

name: Jellyfish Swarm
summary: A drifting bloom of box jellyfish; brushing against the tentacles brings agonizing, paralyzing pain.

name: Barracuda
summary: A sleek, toothy reef fish that strikes at anything shiny in a burst of speed.

name: Electric Eel
summary: A river fish that stuns everything around it with a powerful electrical discharge.

powers.name: Electric Discharge
powers.detail: Limited to targets in contact with the water

name: Bee or Wasp Swarm
summary: An angry cloud of bees, wasps, or hornets that chases intruders and stings any exposed skin.

name: Army Ant Swarm
summary: A marching carpet of millions of ants that devours anything too slow to get out of the way.

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: A mass of many small creatures; pours through any gap and is hard to hurt with single blows

name: Scorpion
summary: A palm-sized desert scorpion with a painful, sometimes deadly sting.

powers.name: Sting
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated

name: Venomous Spider
summary: A black widow, brown recluse, or big tarantula; its bite causes cramps, fever, and collapse.

powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated

name: Bat Swarm
summary: A shrieking cloud of bats pouring out of a cave or belfry, nipping and battering everything in its path.

powers.detail: A mass of many small creatures; pours through any gap and is hard to hurt with single blows

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
summary: The tyrant lizard: forty feet of muscle and teeth, the classic lost-world showstopper.

name: Raptor
summary: A man-sized pack-hunting dinosaur with a sickle claw on each foot and a nasty cunning.

name: Triceratops
summary: A three-horned herbivore the size of a truck, armored with a bony frill and quick to charge.

name: Woolly Mammoth
summary: An ice-age elephant wrapped in shaggy fur, with curving tusks longer than a man.

name: Sabre-tooth Cat
summary: An ice-age ambush predator that pins prey down and stabs with foot-long fangs.

name: Pteranodon
summary: A flying reptile with a twenty-foot wingspan that snatches fish and the occasional explorer.
